description: This file defines the abstract base class `Twig	emplate` which is part of the Twig templating engine. It provides internal mechanisms for template inheritance, block management, rendering, and error handling, serving as a core implementation detail of how compiled templates work in Twig.

classes.name: Twig	emplate
classes.description: Abstract base class used internally by Twig for compiled templates, providing core methods for rendering, block inheritance, and template management.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Provides debug information as an array of line mappings.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source code and metadata of the original template.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent template for inheritance, handling caching and template resolution.

methods.name: doGetParent
methods.description: Internal method to determine the parent template; intended to be overridden.

methods.name: isTraitable
methods.description: Indicates whether the template supports being extended.

methods.name: displayParentBlock
methods.description: Outputs the parent block content.

methods.name: displayBlock
methods.description: Renders a specific block of the template.

methods.name: renderParentBlock
methods.description: Returns the rendered parent block as a string.

methods.name: renderBlock
methods.description: Returns the rendered block as a string, using output buffering.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block exists in current or parent templates.

methods.name: getBlockNames
methods.description: Returns all block names available in the current context.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template instance from various inputs, with deprecation handling.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Returns the current template instance (for internal use).

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Returns the current set of blocks.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the template contents based on the provided context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template as a string.

methods.name: yield
methods.description: Generator that yields parts of the rendered template, supporting features like template inheritance.

methods.name: yieldBlock
methods.description: Generator that yields parts of a specific block, with support for parent blocks and traits.

methods.name: yieldParentBlock
methods.description: Yields the parent block content, used internally for 'parent()' calls.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks for existence of macro methods.

methods.name: getTemplateForMacro
methods.description: Finds the template instance where a macro is defined.

methods.name: doDisplay
methods.description: Abstract method implemented by subclasses that contains the main rendering logic.
